title.narrative: Rehabilitation Project of Pediatric and Adult Intensive Care Units, Emergency and Operations in Four Selected States in the Republic of Sudan

description.narrative: Providing life-saving medical devices in various emergency departments, operations and intensive care units, such as anesthesia machines, operating beds, emergency devices, ventilators, automatic injections, vital signs monitoring devices, intensive care beds, etc., in addition to maintaining these departments, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

The project aims to provide intensive care, emergency and surgical services in 7 major hospitals in four states in Sudan, the most crowded with displaced people due to the armed conflict in Sudan. The weak government funding has caused health facilities to suffer from a significant weakness in infrastructure and most intensive care departments are out of service due to the lack of maintenance and weak government funding. The project is one of the most important projects due to its effective role in reducing citizen deaths in these states by providing life-saving medical devices in emergency departments and various intensive care operations such as anesthesia devices, operating beds, emergency devices, artificial respirators, automatic injections, vital signs monitoring devices, intensive care beds, etc. in addition to maintaining these departments, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

This project will effectively contribute to alleviating the impact of war on Sudanese citizens affected by war by providing intensive care services that Sudanese citizens struggle to provide, as well as increasing the capacity of surgical departments by providing basic equipment for operating and emergency departments.
